The '''Monument to Queen Rana''' was built in homage to [[Rana Mas Trehalt]], a celebrated [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. The monument, which stood in the [[Valley of Royalty]] on Duro, consisted of a giant likeness of the queen's face, looking up to the sky.<ref name="MMY" />
